newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee ends year on flat note.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee ends year on flat note.

text.p: The Sri Lanka rupee closed flat against the dollar in dull holiday mood trading on Monday, the last working day of the year for banks, dealers said.
The rupee closed at 56.70 to the U.S. currency after opening at the same level. Its previous closing level was 56.74.
"There were very few buyers and very few sellers today. It was a very slow day," a Standard Chartered Bank dealer said.
The Central Bank pushed the dollar up 1.75 local cents and fixed buying and selling at 56.1380 and 57.2721 respectively.
Overnight call money, which opened at 25 percent, closed at 19 percent. Tuesday is a bank holiday.
